results.title: Getting Started · Jest
results.snippet: Jest is a JavaScript testing framework with a focus on simplicity. It works with projects using Babel, TypeScript, Node, React, Angular, Vue and more.

results.title: jest - npm
results.snippet: Jest has 50M+ weekly downloads on npm. Startup time ~800ms for medium-sized projects. Maintained by Meta.

results.title: jestjs/jest: Delightful JavaScript Testing - GitHub
results.snippet: Jest is a delightful JavaScript Testing Framework with a focus on simplicity. 44k stars on GitHub. Active maintenance by Meta open source team.

results.title: Jest performance tips in 2024
results.snippet: Jest startup can be slow due to Babel transform overhead. Switching to SWC or ts-jest can reduce startup from 800ms to ~300ms.

results.title: Jest vs Vitest in 2024 — which should you choose?
results.snippet: Jest remains the most downloaded JS testing framework but Vitest is gaining fast in the Vite ecosystem. Jest is harder to configure for ESM.
